active_work.integration_requirement: Consume AAI-01 completed provider/API/license evidence while preserving provider/source/asset/intent separation, explicit rights/capability fail-closed states, silent/unresolved/manual cue states and all World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/gameplay owner truths.

selection_invariants: MAI-01..10 and AAI-01 are completed_verified with exact evidence preserved and no further implementation authority.
AAI-02 is schema/contract/evidence only; provider adapters, playback, resolver, workbench and runtime owner integration are later authority.
No provider/catalog is canonical and no provider is assumed to support every capability.
Audio intent, provider identity and selected provider asset/reference remain separate.
Rights and capability evidence are explicit; unknown is fail-closed and one permission never implies another.
Commercial provider audio is controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license.
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence.
User-owned file possession does not infer public-performance, redistribution or commercial rights.
Audio remains presentation/support state and cannot replace World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/gameplay truth.
Missing or disabled audio never blocks play; unresolved/silent/manual-reference are first-class schema states.
No provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, production provider activation, real-money integration, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
